items.title: 台印CEO論壇首戰印度矽谷 貿協：近10年已有386家台企於當地發展
items.title_en: Taiwan-India CEO Forum Opens in India's Silicon Valley, Trade Association: 386 Taiwanese Companies Have Developed in the Region Over the Past Decade
paras: 由貿協與印度商工總會(FICCI)主辦、經濟部與印度商工部支持辦理的「2026年第5屆台印度CEO圓桌論壇」，上周在有「印度矽谷」美譽的南印度科技重鎮-班加羅爾登場。貿協表示，本屆論壇匯聚了來自台印2國知名企業領袖30餘人與會，圍繞電子製造、製造業供應鏈韌性、能源安全以及中小企業合作等議題展開對話，例如東元(1504-TW)建議印度政府應提升工業馬達最低效能標準，以因應電子業和數據中心等增加之電力需求，提升企業在國際市場之競爭力。
經濟部次長江文若指出，台印雙方產業高度互補，也為未來合作創造了廣闊的發展空間，期待透過CEO論壇持續反映並推動企業所關注的重要議題，包括持續強化Invest India一站式服務功能，協助企業掌握資訊，解決投資遇到的問題，透過論壇提出的各項建言能獲得雙方政府的重視與實質回應，將轉化為具體的政策與措施，以便協助企業克服挑戰、改善投資環境，深化雙邊經貿合作。
印度商工部次長Mr. Amardeep Singh Bhatia說明，論壇透過業者的建言可幫助雙方政府擬定政策與進行產業合作，印度透過多項產業激勵措施與改善經商環境，推動製造及供應鏈升級，期待雙方持續強化合作，深化技術與供應鏈連結。
貿協董事長黃志芳則強調，台印雙邊貿易在近10年間快速成長，並已有386家台廠在印度落地，也展現企業對彼此的信任與合作價值，印度發展成全球製造中心與台灣在先進製造與科技領域的優勢，正為雙方合作揭開全新的篇章。
印方主席Jasbir Singh指出，印度正處於經濟與科技發展的關鍵轉折點，近期是深化合作的最佳時機，本屆論壇的四大主題：電子製造、能源安全、中小企業合作、製造業供應鏈韌性都是極為重要的合作重點，尤其在電子製造部份，台印應積極打造電子零組件供應鏈的生態系。
本屆圓桌論壇也匯聚了來自台印兩國知名企業領袖30餘人與會，例如東元電機建議印度政府應提升工業馬達最低效能標準，以因應電子業和數據中心等增加之電力需求；印方企業則期待雙方在電子製造的供應鏈、製造業自動化和醫療產品都能有更多的合作。
paras_en: The 5th Taiwan-India CEO Roundtable Forum 2026, organized by the Trade Association and the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI) and supported by Taiwan’s Ministry of Economic Affairs and India’s Ministry of Commerce, was held last week in Bengaluru, the South Indian tech hub known as India’s Silicon Valley. The forum brought together more than 30 prominent leaders from Taiwanese and Indian companies, discussing topics such as electronic manufacturing, supply‑chain resilience in manufacturing, energy security, and SME collaboration. For example, TECO Electric (1504‑TW) urged the Indian government to raise the minimum efficiency standards for industrial motors to meet the growing power demand of the electronics sector and data centers, thereby enhancing competitiveness in the global market.

Deputy Minister of Economic Affairs, Jiang Wenruo, noted that the industries of Taiwan and India are highly complementary, creating vast opportunities for future collaboration. He expressed hope that the CEO forum would continue to highlight and advance key issues of concern to businesses, including strengthening the one‑stop service function of Invest India, helping companies access information, solve investment challenges, and ensuring that the recommendations from the forum receive serious attention and concrete responses from both governments, translating into specific policies and measures to help firms overcome obstacles, improve the investment climate, and deepen bilateral economic and trade cooperation.

Mr. Amardeep Singh Bhatia, Deputy Minister of India’s Ministry of Commerce, explained that the forum’s industry recommendations help both governments formulate policies and conduct industrial cooperation. India’s various industrial incentives and improvements to the business environment are driving manufacturing and supply‑chain upgrades, and both sides are expected to continue strengthening collaboration and deepening technology and supply‑chain linkages.

Chairman of the Trade Association, Huang Zhifang, emphasized that bilateral trade between Taiwan and India has grown rapidly over the past decade, with 386 Taiwanese factories already established in India, demonstrating mutual trust and the value of cooperation. India’s development into a global manufacturing hub, combined with Taiwan’s strengths in advanced manufacturing and technology, is opening a new chapter for collaboration.

Chairman of the Indian side, Jasbir Singh, pointed out that India is at a critical turning point in its economic and technological development, making the current period the best time to deepen cooperation. The forum’s four main themes—electronic manufacturing, energy security, SME collaboration, and manufacturing supply‑chain resilience—are all crucial collaboration focal points, especially in electronic manufacturing, where Taiwan and India should actively build an ecosystem for electronic component supply chains.

The roundtable also gathered more than 30 prominent leaders from Taiwanese and Indian companies. For instance, TECO Electric suggested that the Indian government raise the minimum efficiency standards for industrial motors to meet the increased power demand of the electronics industry and data centers. Indian companies, meanwhile, look forward to greater collaboration in electronic manufacturing supply chains, manufacturing automation, and medical products.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉台積電水冷新藍圖激勵 奇鋐衝3525元再創歷史新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: TSMC’s New Water‑Cooling Blueprint Fuels Qihong Surge to NT$3,525, Setting Record High
paras: 奇鋐(3017-TW)持續受惠伺服器產品需求暢旺，其中又以ASIC動能最為強勁，使得產品組合轉佳，法人預期，奇鋐第三季在伺服器產品出貨優於預期帶動下，第三季營收可望季增近2成，激勵奇鋐今(3)日走揚，衝上3525元再創歷史新天價。
奇鋐今天早盤以3395元開高走高，盤中最高漲至3525元，漲逾半根停板，創歷史新天價，隨後漲幅收斂，截至午盤，股價暫報3415元，漲逾3%，站上5日線，排名千金股第13名，成交量超過3000張。
奇鋐除第三季展望正面，法人也看好動能延續至第四季，主要動能將來自輝達(NVDA-US)VR產品，加上水冷板砍價疑慮消失，單價與份額可望提升，將進一步推升奇鋐水冷產品貢獻，預期第四季營收與獲利有望同步成長。同時，奇鋐AMD(AMD-US)MI400水冷出貨份額也可望增加，預期營收貢獻也將顯著提升。整體而言，下半年將逐季增溫。
另外，近期台積電(2330-TW)與AMD近日揭示下一階段水冷技術藍圖，業界傳出，奇鋐已參與相關技術開發，明年中客戶新平台進入量產後，可望搶食商機。
paras_en: Qihong (3017‑TW) continues to benefit from strong demand for server products, with ASIC momentum being the strongest, improving its product mix. Institutional investors expect Qihong’s third‑quarter revenue to rise by nearly 20% year‑over‑year as server shipments exceed expectations, driving the stock up today (the 3rd) to NT$3,525, a new historical peak.

In early trading today Qihong opened at NT$3,395 and climbed higher, reaching a intraday high of NT$3,525—up more than half a limit‑up tick and setting a new all‑time high. The rally then moderated; by midday the price was around NT$3,415, up over 3%, above the 5‑day moving average and ranking 13th among the “golden” stocks, with volume exceeding 3,000 lots.

Beyond the positive Q3 outlook, institutions are optimistic that the momentum will carry into Q4, driven mainly by NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) VR products and the disappearance of price‑cut concerns for water‑cooling plates, which should lift unit prices and market share and further boost Qihong’s water‑cooling contribution. Revenue and profit are expected to grow in tandem in Q4. At the same time, Qihong’s share of AMD (AMD‑US) MI400 water‑cooling shipments is also expected to rise, significantly enhancing revenue contribution. Overall, the second half of the year is projected to warm up quarter by quarter.

Recently, TSMC (2330‑TW) and AMD disclosed the next‑stage water‑cooling technology roadmap. Industry sources say Qihong has joined the related R&D, and once customers’ new platforms enter mass production mid‑next year, the company is poised to capture new business opportunities.

items.title: SpaceX的AI優勢有多大？分析師看好股價翻倍
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，分析師認為，SpaceX(SPCX-US)的AI部門正快速成長，在一項關鍵資源持續短缺之際，這將為公司帶來巨大優勢。
AI產業對運算能力的需求十分龐大，企業需要大量算力來訓練及運行模型。根據PwC最新報告，為了建置AI所需的運算能力，企業預計到2050年將投入36.1兆美元，主要用於投資資料中心及相關技術。
Oppenheimer分析師Timothy Horan在周三(2日)給客戶的報告中表示，SpaceX有望成為短期算力供應短缺下的贏家。Horan認為，SpaceX「有能力以比任何其他公司更快的速度擴充基礎設施，並利用這些基礎設施及取得的數據，以更快的速度改善自身模型」。
Horan給予SpaceX股票「買進」評級，並將目標價從250美元上調至280美元。新的目標價意味著SpaceX股價較目前水準約有100%上漲空間。
SpaceX計劃將運算能力從目前的1.4GW擴增至2026年底的逾2GW。馬斯克在財報電話會議上表示，SpaceX目標是在2027年底前，讓運算能力「更接近10GW，而不是5GW」。他並補充，公司希望屆時擁有20GW的電力與冷卻能力。
根據瑞穗，要達成SpaceX 2027年的算力目標，可能需要投入3,000億至5,000億美元。這可能迫使公司進一步舉債。摩根士丹利分析師Adam Jonas表示，SpaceX到2035年平均每年需要新增800億美元淨負債。看好SpaceX的Jonas在給客戶的報告中指出，SpaceX今年預計將投入530億美元於AI。
SpaceX認為這些投資將帶來回報。SpaceX財務長Bret Johnsen上個月告訴投資人，公司從建置AI運算能力所投入的資金，可以在不到一年內回收。
這主要得益於與Alphabet、Anthropic及至少另外兩家客戶簽訂的算力租賃合約。這些合約將在未來數年為SpaceX帶來數百億美元營收，不過Alphabet與Anthropic的合約都允許雙方提前終止合作。
Horan表示，「在算力持續緊張的環境下，我們預期SPCX能夠取得Anthropic等合作夥伴利用SpaceX算力所創造營收的每1美元中的50%。」
除了出租算力之外，SpaceX也利用自身資源訓練旗下AI模型Grok。公司近期也完成對AI新創Cursor的收購，Horan形容這項收購具「轉型性」作用，有助於SpaceX開發模型並創造額外營收。
周二在Anthropic發布最新AI模型後不久，馬斯克表示SpaceX將在10天後推出最新版本Grok 4.7。SpaceX不到一個月前才發布Grok 4.6，根據Artificial Analysis，該模型具備強大的能力，且成本低於部分領先AI模型。

items.title: 雪佛龍宣布未來五年投資70億美元 委內瑞拉石油產量翻倍
items.title_en: Chevron Announces $7 B Investment Over Five Years, Plans to Double Venezuela Oil Production
paras: 美國石油巨頭雪佛龍(CVX-US) 周三（2日）宣布，將投資超過70億美元，計劃未來五年內將其在委內瑞拉的原油產量翻番至約60萬桶/日，進一步擴大在當地業務布局。
就在幾天前，美國總統川普宣布，他達成了一筆「世界史上最大石油交易」：美國正聯合私營企業取得委內瑞拉650億桶探明石油儲量的控制權。
雪佛龍是目前唯一一家在委內瑞拉擁有大規模業務布局的美國石油公司。雪佛龍周三表示，已獲得委內瑞拉奧里諾科重油帶的新增區塊，此前雪佛龍已在該地區建立穩固業務基礎。
根據雙方合資計畫，雪佛龍將在未來五年投資超過70億美元，預計石油產量將較2026年翻一倍以上，增至約60萬桶/日。
委內瑞拉擁有全球最大已探明石油儲量，總量超過3,030億桶。但多年來管理不善、腐敗、投資不足以及美國制裁，委內瑞拉石油產業遭嚴重削弱。
委內瑞拉石油產量在上世紀90年代末曾達到逾300萬桶/日峰值，此後大幅下滑。近幾個月來，委內瑞拉產量一直維持在110萬至120萬桶/日左右。
此次新增區塊以及更加優惠的經營條件，將進一步擴大雪佛龍在委內瑞拉的業務版圖。近期雪佛龍在委內瑞拉的原油產量約29萬桶/日，且全部出口至美國。
川普今年1月抓捕委內瑞拉總統馬杜洛後，一直推動一項規模達1,000億美元的委內瑞拉能源產業重建計畫，並敦促美國石油企業投資委內瑞拉。
paras_en: U.S. oil giant Chevron (CVX-US) announced on Wednesday the 2nd that it will invest more than $7 billion to double its crude oil output in Venezuela to about 600,000 barrels per day over the next five years, further expanding its local footprint.

Just days earlier, U.S. President Trump declared he had secured a "world‑record oil deal": the United States, together with private firms, would gain control of Venezuela’s 650 billion‑barrel proven oil reserves.

Chevron is currently the only U.S. oil company with a large‑scale presence in Venezuela. On Wednesday the company said it had been awarded new blocks in the Orinoco heavy‑oil belt, building on an already solid base in the region.

Under the joint‑venture plan, Chevron will pour more than $7 billion into the project over the next five years, with oil production expected to more than double its 2026 level to roughly 600,000 barrels per day.

Venezuela holds the world’s largest proven oil reserves, exceeding 303 billion barrels, but years of mismanagement, corruption, under‑investment and U.S. sanctions have severely weakened its oil sector.
Venezuela’s oil output peaked at over 3 million barrels per day in the late 1990s before plunging sharply; in recent months production has hovered around 1.1‑1.2 million barrels per day.

The new blocks and more favorable operating terms will further expand Chevron’s footprint in Venezuela. Currently the company produces about 290,000 barrels per day of crude there, all of which is exported to the United States.

Since President Trump’s January arrest of Venezuelan President Maduro, he has been pushing a $100 billion plan to rebuild Venezuela’s energy industry and urging U.S. oil firms to invest in the country.

items.title: 博通財報優、AI營收強勁 為何仍一度重挫5%？
items.title_en: Broadcom's Strong Earnings and AI Revenue Yet Stock Slid 5% at One Point—Why?
paras: 《Yhaoo Finance》報導，博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)股價周三(2日)盤後一度重挫5%，隨後跌幅收斂。
這家AI晶片與網路設備大廠受惠於強勁的AI需求，營收持續成長，但財報表現仍不足以推動股價上漲。財報公布後，博通股價立即下挫，之後跌幅逐步收斂。
StoneX金融股票研究分析師Cody Acree表示，「我可以理解市場賣壓。」Acree給予博通股票「買進」評級，但他指出，這家晶片大廠第三季營收與獲利優於預期「仍不足以讓投資人滿意」。
Acree表示，「從營收與獲利表現來看，這次財報優於預期並上修財測的幅度，還不夠大。畢竟這是一家高度受惠於AI的公司。」
博通調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為3.32美元，高於華爾街預期的3.23美元。單季營收年增86%至296億美元，也優於市場預期的294.5億美元。
博通表示，第三季AI半導體營收達167億美元，年增221%，季增54%。
博通預估，目前一季(第四季)營收將達348億美元，低於彭博數據所統計分析師預期的350.5億美元。
隨著科技巨頭競相開發客製化晶片並擴建資料中心，博通營收大幅成長。
博通執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)在財報新聞稿中表示，「市場對我們客製化AI加速器與網路產品的需求持續非常強勁。」
博通股價今年以來上漲6%，相較之下，同業輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)上漲20%。
Acree表示，「就資料中心整體生態系而言，博通真的只落後於輝達。」他指出，「現在只是在於何時進場，以及如何因應持有部位進行交易。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Broadcom (AVGO-US) shares fell as much as 5% after hours on Wednesday (the 2nd), before the decline narrowed.

The AI chip and networking equipment giant has benefited from robust AI demand, with revenue continuing to grow, but its earnings report was not enough to lift the stock. After the results were released, Broadcom’s share price dropped immediately, then the loss gradually narrowed.

StoneX financial equity research analyst Cody Acree said, "I can understand the market’s selling pressure." Acree gave Broadcom a "Buy" rating, but noted that the chip maker’s third‑quarter revenue and profit, while better than expected, "still aren’t enough to satisfy investors."
Acree added, "Looking at revenue and profit performance, the beat and the upward revision of forecasts this time aren’t large enough. After all, this is a company that is heavily benefiting from AI."

Broadcom reported adjusted earnings per share of $3.32, above Wall Street’s expectation of $3.23. Quarterly revenue rose 86% year‑over‑year to $29.6 billion, also beating the market forecast of $29.45 billion.
Broadcom said AI semiconductor revenue for the third quarter reached $16.7 billion, up 221% year‑over‑year and 54% sequentially.
Broadcom forecasts that current quarter (fourth quarter) revenue will be $34.8 billion, below Bloomberg’s consensus estimate of $35.05 billion from analysts.
As tech giants race to develop custom chips and expand data centers, Broadcom’s revenue has surged dramatically.
Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said in the earnings press release, "Demand for our custom AI accelerators and networking products remains very strong in the market."
Broadcom’s stock is up 6% year‑to‑date, compared with peers Nvidia (NVDA-US), which is up about 20%.
Acree said, "In the overall data‑center ecosystem, Broadcom really is only behind Nvidia." He added, "The question now is timing of entry and how to manage positions once you hold them."

items.title: 台積電憑什麼牢牢抓住蘋果？英特爾最難追的不是製程
items.title_en: How TSMC Keeps a Firm Grip on Apple: The Hardest Thing for Intel to Catch Up Is Not the Process
paras: 《AppleInsider》引述半導體研究機構《Culpium》報導，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 能長期穩居蘋果 (AAPL-US) 核心晶片供應商，靠的不只是先進製程與量產能力，更重要的是數十年累積的客戶信任。英特爾 (INTC-US) 即使重新取得蘋果部分晶片業務，仍難以複製雙方的合作關係。
蘋果2020年開始讓Mac告別英特爾處理器，全面轉向自行設計的Apple Silicon，並由台積電負責製造。這項轉變為蘋果帶來更高的軟硬體整合能力，也讓台積電進一步鞏固在蘋果供應鏈中的地位。
儘管美國總統川普今年6月宣布，蘋果已同意與英特爾合作，在美國生產部分晶片，但這並不代表蘋果重回英特爾懷抱。英特爾目前面臨的核心問題，也不只是製程技術能否追上台積電，而是能否讓蘋果相信其具備足夠產能、穩定交付能力與保密意識。
台積電不與客戶競爭 先取得蘋果信任
蘋果早年曾邀請英特爾生產行動裝置處理器，但遭到拒絕，之後改由三星電子供應。然而，三星既是晶片供應商，也是蘋果在消費電子市場的競爭對手，加上三星參與Google母公司Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 的Android生態系，使時任蘋果執行長賈伯斯對其有所顧慮。
台積電的商業模式正好解決了這項問題。台積電專注替客戶製造晶片，不推出與客戶競爭的自有品牌處理器，因此得以在合作過程中保持中立。台積電先後服務輝達 (NVDA-US)、高通 (QCOM-US) 等晶片設計公司，也逐步證明自己能夠保護客戶技術與商業機密。
2010年底，鴻海 (2317-TW) 創辦人郭台銘安排台積電創辦人張忠謀與蘋果營運主管傑夫·威廉斯 (Jeff Williams) 會面。威廉斯當時提出，希望台積電成為蘋果的晶片代工商，甚至承接蘋果全部訂單。
雙方經過數月談判後，蘋果一度暫停合作計畫，轉而評估英特爾的代工能力。張忠謀當時並未感到憂心，因為他認為，蘋果選擇供應商時重視的三項條件，分別是技術、製造能力與信任，而英特爾在這些方面並未優於台積電。
2011年3月，當時擔任蘋果代理執行長的庫克向張忠謀表示，英特爾不知道該如何經營晶圓代工業務。這也讓張忠謀更加確信，台積電真正的優勢不只是生產晶片，而是懂得如何服務客戶。
英特爾陷入先有訂單、還是先擴產的困局
英特爾近年積極發展晶圓代工業務，希望重新爭取蘋果等大型客戶，但財務與產能策略卻形成阻礙。
陳立武2025年3月接掌英特爾後，強調公司不能再無限制投入資金，因而放慢俄亥俄州晶圓廠建設進度，並取消原訂在德國與波蘭興建工廠的計畫。英特爾也不願在客戶正式承諾下單前，提前建置大量產能。
問題在於，蘋果等大型客戶同樣不願在英特爾證明產能及交付能力前交出訂單。英特爾希望先取得訂單再擴產，客戶卻要求先看到產能才願意下單，使英特爾陷入難以突破的兩難。
儘管如此，在白宮推動晶片美國製造的政策壓力下，英特爾仍持續爭取外部客戶，並成功與Alphabet、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 及輝達展開合作。
爭取蘋果訂單 卻踩中保密紅線
除了產能疑慮，英特爾在爭取蘋果訂單時還犯下保密失誤。
英特爾曾為了向蘋果證明公司能迅速增加產能，透露已與設備供應商討論採購事宜。然而，英特爾在相關談判中宣稱蘋果已是其客戶，並以此要求設備供應商優先供貨。
這項做法直接踩到蘋果高度重視的保密紅線。英特爾不僅在合作尚未正式確定前使用蘋果名義爭取設備，還主動向蘋果透露此事，反而證明公司未必能妥善保護客戶資訊。
技術與產能可以投資 信任只能長期累積
受到當前半導體產業供需與美國製造布局影響，蘋果仍選擇與英特爾合作，但雙方關係與蘋果、台積電之間的長期夥伴模式仍有明顯差距。
台積電多年來對客戶身分與合作內容保持低調，同時堅持不與客戶競爭。這套經營模式讓台積電能持續承接蘋果訂單，也使信任成為其他晶圓代工業者難以跨越的門檻。
台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家今年7月向投資人表示，技術研發與製造產能固然重要，但信任無法像到便利商店購買牛奶一樣，隨時都能取得。對英特爾而言，製程與產能仍可透過投資改善，但要重新取得蘋果信任，顯然需要更長時間。
paras_en: AppleInsider, citing semiconductor research firm Culpium, reports that TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) can remain Apple’s (AAPL‑US) core chip supplier for the long term not only because of its advanced processes and mass‑production capability, but more importantly due to decades of accumulated customer trust. Even if Intel (INTC‑US) regains some of Apple’s chip business, it will still struggle to replicate the partnership.

Apple began phasing Intel processors out of Macs in 2020, moving entirely to its own Apple Silicon designs manufactured by TSMC. The shift gave Apple tighter hardware‑software integration and further cemented TSMC’s position in Apple’s supply chain.

Although President Trump announced in June that Apple had agreed to work with Intel to produce some chips in the United States, this does not mean Apple is returning to Intel’s embrace. Intel’s core challenge is not merely catching TSMC’s process technology, but convincing Apple that it has sufficient capacity, reliable delivery and strong confidentiality.
TSMC Does Not Compete With Customers – First Gaining Apple’s Trust

Apple once invited Intel to produce mobile‑device processors, but Intel declined and Apple turned to Samsung. Samsung, however, is both a chip supplier and a competitor to Apple in consumer electronics, and its involvement in Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) Android ecosystem gave then‑CEO Steve Jobs cause for concern.

TSMC’s business model solves that dilemma. It focuses solely on manufacturing chips for customers and does not sell its own competing processors, allowing it to stay neutral. TSMC has served companies such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US), gradually proving its ability to protect customers’ technology and commercial secrets.

At the end of 2010, Foxconn founder Terry Gou arranged a meeting between TSMC founder Morris Chang and Apple operations chief Jeff Williams. Williams then asked TSMC to become Apple’s chip foundry and even to take all of Apple’s orders.

After months of talks, Apple briefly paused the project to evaluate Intel’s foundry capability. Chang was not worried, believing Apple values three criteria when choosing a supplier – technology, manufacturing capability and trust – and Intel did not surpass TSMC on any of them.

In March 2011, then‑Apple CEO Tim Cook told Chang that Intel did not know how to run a wafer‑foundry business. This reinforced Chang’s belief that TSMC’s advantage lies not only in chip production but in understanding how to serve customers.
Intel Caught in the Catch‑22 of Orders Versus Capacity Expansion
In recent years Intel has pushed hard into wafer‑foundry services to win back large customers like Apple, but its financial and capacity strategies have become obstacles.

After Chen Liwu took over Intel in March 2025, he stressed that the company could no longer pour unlimited money into expansion, slowing construction of the Ohio fab and scrapping plans for factories in Germany and Poland. Intel also refuses to build large capacity before customers formally commit orders.

The problem is that big customers such as Apple also refuse to place orders before Intel proves its capacity and delivery reliability. Intel wants orders first and then to scale up; customers want capacity first, putting Intel in a dead‑end dilemma.
Nevertheless, under White House pressure to “Make Chips in America,” Intel continues to chase external customers and has secured deals with Alphabet, Tesla (TSLA‑US) and Nvidia.
Chasing Apple’s Order Yet Tripping Over Confidentiality Rules
Beyond capacity concerns, Intel made a confidentiality slip while pursuing Apple’s business.
To demonstrate rapid capacity expansion, Intel disclosed that it had discussed equipment purchases with suppliers, even claiming Apple was already a customer to secure priority supply.

That move crossed Apple’s strict confidentiality line. Intel not only used Apple’s name before any formal agreement but also informed Apple of the claim, showing it might not safeguard client information properly.
Technology and Capacity Can Be Invested in; Trust Must Be Built Over Time

Affected by current semiconductor supply‑demand dynamics and U.S. manufacturing policies, Apple still chooses to work with Intel, but the relationship remains far from the long‑term partnership Apple enjoys with TSMC.

TSMC has long kept customer identities and deal details low‑key while steadfastly refusing to compete with them. This model lets TSMC continuously win Apple orders and makes trust a barrier other foundries find hard to cross.

Wei Zhejia, TSMC’s chairman and CEO, told investors in July that while R&D and manufacturing capacity are important, trust cannot be bought off a convenience‑store shelf. For Intel, process technology and capacity can be improved with investment, but regaining Apple’s trust will clearly take much longer.

items.title: 輝達今年在美投入近兆美元！黃仁勳：AI如水電等基礎設施 每個國家都要建設
items.title_en: NVIDIA invests nearly a trillion dollars in the US this year! Jensen Huang: AI is as fundamental as water and electricity infrastructure, every country must build it
paras: 輝達執行長黃仁勳週三(2日)在美國北卡羅來納州教堂山舉行的G20創新部長級會議上，把AI直呼為「水、電級公共基礎設施建設」，警告各國若對AI監管過度，「最糟結果就是被落下」。他並透露輝達光是今年一年就在美國AI基礎設施投入近1兆美元，還說AI是「最大均衡器」，每個國家都該自建算力支撐本國經濟。
他在跟美國商務部長盧特尼克對談時也表示：政府該管的是「實質、具體危害」，別管「理論、假設性危害」，產品安全由企業自負，技術仍在成形期，「每家公司必須自覺負起安全開發責任」。
黃仁勳在G20上的表態強化了「全球 AI 資本支出持續擴張」預期，上兆美元的美國基礎設施建設承諾，也將算力軍備競賽從企業預算拉高到國家主權層次。
馬斯克週二(1日)也呼籲新事物默認合法，並點名歐盟「極高監管扼殺增長」；Anthropic共同創辦人Tom Brown雖以安全護欄著稱，但在G20上仍強調資料中心是瓶頸，「電力與勞動力嚴重短缺」，並稱讚川普為資料中心建設背書。
這場高峰會由美國主辦，商務部長盧特尼克與白宮科技顧問Michael Kratsios力推《卡羅來納原則》，不另設AI專屬監管機構，改用產官協作測試新興技術，僅針對「新穎情形」補充規則。
paras_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said on Wednesday (the 2nd) at the G20 Innovation Ministers’ meeting in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, that AI is a "water‑ and electricity‑level public infrastructure" and warned that over‑regulation could leave countries "falling behind". He disclosed that NVIDIA alone has invested close to $1 trillion in AI infrastructure in the United States this year, calling AI the "great equalizer" and urging every nation to develop its own compute capacity to support its economy.

During a conversation with U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, Huang said governments should regulate only "real, concrete harms" and not "theoretical or speculative risks," that product safety is the responsibility of companies, and that the technology is still in its formative stage, so "each company must voluntarily assume responsibility for safe development."

Huang’s remarks at the G20 reinforced expectations that global AI capital spending will continue to expand, and the U.S. infrastructure commitment of a trillion dollars lifts the compute‑arms race from corporate budgets to the level of national sovereignty.

Elon Musk also called on Tuesday (the 1st) for new technologies to be presumed legal and singled out the EU for "excessive regulation that stifles growth"; Anthropic co‑founder Tom Brown, known for his safety‑first stance, still emphasized at the G20 that data centers are a bottleneck, citing "severe shortages of power and labor," and praised former President Trump for backing data‑center construction.

The summit, hosted by the United States, saw Commerce Secretary Raimondo and White House technology adviser Michael Kratsios push the "Carolina Principles," which propose no separate AI regulator but instead a public‑private collaboration to test emerging technologies, adding rules only for "novel situations."

items.title: 美債拉警報！海外美資產避險比率創逾十年低　專家：貶值交易回溫 美元若崩將引發連續爆倉
items.title_en: US Bonds Raise Alarm! Overseas US Asset Hedging Ratio Hits Ten-Year Low; Experts Say Depreciation Trades Are Heating Up, and a Dollar Collapse Could Trigger Continuous Liquidations
paras: 外媒最新報導出，根據日本、加拿大、台灣、澳洲、丹麥及芬蘭等六地退休基金與保險公司申報文件，截至今年6月30日，海外投資人持有美股美債的外幣曝險避險比率僅約41%，創2015年來新低。
去年川普推出全球關稅、美元急貶時，上述避險比率曾短暫跳升，但這股熱潮隨著美元回穩、避險成本居高不下而迅速消退，投資人重回「波動時美元自動避險」的舊策略，也就是靠美元升值緩衝本幣計價的美國資產回撤，省下昂貴的衍生品費用。
但美元本季跌約2%、兌多數G10貨幣走弱，「貶值交易」(debasement trade)重新升溫，加上美日聯手干預日元、美國財政部擴大長債回購來壓抑殖利率，加上市場質疑聯準會(Fed)主席華許會否真升息抗通膨，均加劇「美國政策侵蝕美元」的敘事。
匯率避險是利用衍生性商品賣出美元、買進投資人本國貨幣，以防範匯率波動。由於美國資產在全球投資組合中佔有很大比重，增加避險其實意味著更多美元賣盤。
管理1.4兆美元的Nuveen宏觀信貸主管Laura Coope指出，海外持美資產規模龐大，避險比率只需小幅上調，就能撬動可觀外匯流量。根據測算，上述六地合計4.6兆美元外幣部位中，避險比率每上升5個百分點，等於約2300億美元交易量。
雖然上述估算未納入英國和歐元區等主要市場，但所涵蓋國家仍占美國資產海外持有量相當大的一部分。日本是全球最大的美國國債海外持有國，佔外國持有量約10%，加拿大和台灣也高居前十名。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that, based on filing documents from pension funds and insurance companies in Japan, Canada, Taiwan, Australia, Denmark and Finland, the foreign‑currency hedging ratio for overseas investors’ US equity and US Treasury holdings was only about 41% as of June 30 this year, a new low not seen since 2015.

Last year, when President Trump rolled out global tariffs and the dollar sharply depreciated, the hedging ratio briefly spiked, but the rally faded quickly as the dollar steadied and hedging costs remained high. Investors reverted to the old “automatic dollar hedge in volatile times” approach—relying on a stronger dollar to cushion the pull‑back of US‑denominated assets priced in local currencies and saving on expensive derivatives fees.

However, the dollar has fallen roughly 2% this quarter and weakened against most G10 currencies, reviving “debasement trades.” Combined with coordinated US‑Japan intervention in the yen, the US Treasury’s expanded long‑bond buybacks to suppress yields, and market doubts about whether Fed Chair Jerome Powell will truly raise rates to combat inflation, the narrative that “US policy is eroding the dollar” has intensified.

Currency hedging uses derivatives to sell dollars and buy the investor’s home currency to guard against exchange‑rate swings. Because US assets make up a large share of global portfolios, increasing hedges actually means more dollar selling pressure.

Laura Coope, head of macro credit at Nuveen, which manages $1.4 trillion, notes that overseas holdings of US assets are massive, and a modest uptick in the hedging ratio could mobilise a sizable FX flow. Her calculations show that among the six jurisdictions, the combined $4.6 trillion foreign‑currency exposure would generate about $230 billion of transaction volume for each 5‑percentage‑point rise in the hedging ratio.

Although the estimate excludes major markets such as the UK and the euro‑area, the covered countries still represent a substantial share of overseas US‑asset holdings. Japan is the world’s largest foreign holder of US Treasury bonds, accounting for roughly 10% of foreign holdings, with Canada and Taiwan also ranking among the top ten.

items.title: 微軟將首度公布Azure單季營收 整併事業部門、調整財報架構
items.title_en: Microsoft to First Publish Quarterly Azure Revenue, Consolidate Business Segments and Revise Reporting Structure
paras: 《CNBC》報導，微軟(Microsoft)(MSFT-US)將首次公布Azure雲端業務的單季營收，讓投資人能更清楚掌握這項與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)AWS及Google(GOOGL-US)雲端平台競爭的業務表現。
微軟周三(2日)在一份簡報中宣布這項變革，這也是公司調整財報架構的一環。微軟將把營運事業部門從原本的3個縮減至2個，現行架構自2015年起沿用至今。
隨著客戶轉向大型雲端基礎設施平台，取得開發新型代理及其他工具所需的AI模型，微軟Azure成為這波人工智慧熱潮的主要受益者之一。Stifel分析師7月估計，微軟2026會計年度Azure營收成長中，約有一半來自OpenAI，而Anthropic對微軟雲端服務的依賴程度也持續提高。
微軟執行長Satya Nadella在簡報中寫道，「毫無疑問，AI正帶來科技與商業模式的重大轉變。它正在改變我們打造產品的方式與營運方式，也正在模糊產品之間的界線，並重新塑造我們的商業模式。」
雲端市場龍頭亞馬遜早在2015年就開始公布AWS營收。Alphabet排名全球雲端市場第三，該公司自2020年起開始公布Google Cloud Platform及Workspace生產力軟體訂閱服務的總營收。
相較之下，微軟過去僅公布Azure年增率，直到去年才開始公布Azure的實際銷售額，而且是以年度為單位。
Azure另一項重大變革，是未來將不再納入GitHub雲端服務、開發者雲端服務、Security Copilot助理，以及醫療與生命科學雲端產品。微軟2021年開始公布Azure及其他雲端服務的成長率，之後又將部分來自GitHub及Nuance Communications收購案的營收納入其中。
Nadella寫道，「在新的財報架構下，Azure將更純粹的代表以用量計費為基礎的雲端平台與基礎設施業務。」
未來微軟將分為兩大事業部門：「Agents and Infra」及「Devices and Consumer」。
前者將包括Azure與Microsoft 365雲端產品、生產力軟體與伺服器授權、產業解決方案，以及先進技術與支援服務。後者將涵蓋搜尋與廣告、Xbox，以及裝置銷售和向裝置製造商授權Windows作業系統所產生的營收。
在「Agents and Infra」事業部門下，微軟將能更清楚呈現一系列AI助理的成長動能，包括面向商業客戶的Microsoft 365 Copilot，以及GitHub Copilot程式碼代理。微軟7月表示，Microsoft 365 Copilot的付費席次已超過3,000萬，高於4月的逾2,000萬。
微軟也將提供重新編製後兩年的財務結果及調整後財測，但未來將停止公布原有3個事業部門的成本與營業利益率。
按照新的財報架構，微軟6月一季Azure營收年增42%至294.2億美元，若按照舊的「Azure及其他雲端服務」計算方式，則為年增43%。這意味著Azure在最新一季已占微軟總營收近33%。
微軟管理層表示，在不計匯率變動情況下，Azure第一季營收預計成長44%至45%。微軟7月原先預估，Azure及其他雲端服務營收在固定匯率下將成長45%。
微軟預估，「Agents and Infra」部門營收將達751.5億至757.5億美元，「Devices and Consumer」營收則為147億至152億美元。整體營收、營收成本及營業費用的財測均維持不變。
paras_en: CNBC reports that Microsoft (MSFT-US) will for the first time disclose Azure cloud business’s quarterly revenue, giving investors clearer insight into its performance against Amazon (AMZN-US) AWS and Google (GOOGL-US) cloud platforms.

Microsoft announced the change in a presentation on Wednesday the 2nd, part of a broader overhaul of its reporting structure. The company will reduce its operating segments from three to two, ending a framework that has been in place since 2015.

As customers shift to large‑scale cloud infrastructure platforms and need AI models to develop new agents and other tools, Microsoft Azure has become one of the main beneficiaries of the AI boom. Stifel analysts estimate that in Microsoft’s fiscal 2026, about half of Azure’s revenue growth will come from OpenAI, while reliance on Azure by Anthropic is also rising.

CEO Satya Nadella wrote in the presentation, “There is no doubt that AI is driving a profound transformation in technology and business models. It is changing how we build products and operate, blurring the lines between products and reshaping our business model.”

Amazon, the cloud market leader, began reporting AWS revenue back in 2015. Alphabet ranks third globally and has been reporting total revenue from Google Cloud Platform and Workspace subscription services since 2020.
By contrast, Microsoft previously only disclosed Azure’s year‑over‑year growth rate and only started reporting actual Azure sales last year, and that on an annual basis.

Another major change for Azure is that it will no longer include GitHub cloud services, developer cloud services, the Security Copilot assistant, or health‑and‑life‑sciences cloud products. Microsoft began reporting Azure and other cloud services growth rates in 2021 and later folded in revenue from the GitHub and Nuance Communications acquisitions.
Nadella wrote, “Under the new reporting structure, Azure will more purely represent the usage‑based cloud platform and infrastructure business.”
Going forward, Microsoft will split into two large segments: “Agents and Infra” and “Devices and Consumer.”

The former will encompass Azure and Microsoft 365 cloud products, productivity software and server licenses, industry solutions, as well as advanced technology and support services. The latter will cover search and advertising, Xbox, device sales and revenue from licensing the Windows operating system to device manufacturers.

Within the “Agents and Infra” segment, Microsoft will be able to showcase the growth momentum of a suite of AI assistants, including Microsoft 365 Copilot for enterprise customers and GitHub Copilot code assistant. In July, Microsoft said paid seats for Microsoft 365 Copilot had topped 30 million, up from over 20 million in April.
Microsoft will also provide re‑issued two‑year financial results and adjusted forecasts, but will cease reporting cost and operating margin for the previous three segments.

Under the new reporting structure, Microsoft said Azure revenue for the June quarter grew 42% year‑over‑year to $29.42 billion; using the old “Azure and other cloud services” calculation it would be a 43% increase. This means Azure now accounts for nearly 33% of Microsoft’s total revenue.

Management indicated that, excluding currency effects, Azure Q1 revenue is expected to grow 44%‑45%. In July, Microsoft had originally projected Azure and other cloud services revenue to grow 45% on a constant‑currency basis.

Microsoft forecasts “Agents and Infra” revenue at $75.15 billion to $75.75 billion and “Devices and Consumer” revenue at $14.7 billion to $15.2 billion, with overall revenue, cost of revenue and operating expense forecasts unchanged.

items.title: Uber倫敦推自駕叫車！Wayve AI上陣 免費升級自駕體驗 唯初期不到20輛上路
items.title_en: Uber Launches Autonomous Ride-Hailing in London with Wayve AI, Free Upgrade Experience for First 20 Vehicles
paras: Uber Technologies (UBER-US)與英國人工智慧自駕車新創Wayve週三(2日)宣布，正式在倫敦推出由人工智慧驅動的自動駕駛叫車服務，讓倫敦成為Uber在歐洲第二座提供機器人計程車服務的城市。初期車隊不到20輛，車內仍配備經許可的安全操作員監控，真正完全無人駕駛服務則要等後續監管核准。
Uber表示，倫敦用戶透過App叫車時，若選擇UberX、Uber Comfort或Uber Electric，均可能免費配對到搭載Wayve自駕技術的全電動Ford Mustang Mach-E。若被配對到Wayve自駕車，用戶可在車輛抵達前選擇接受自駕行程，也可以改叫一般非自駕車輛，車資不會因搭乘自駕車而額外增加。
此次服務是英國首次向一般乘客提供自動駕駛叫車體驗，也讓Uber搶在Google母公司Alphabet (GOOGL-US)旗下Waymo之前，成為首家在倫敦推出商業機器人計程車服務的業者。Waymo原本也計畫在今年稍晚於倫敦推出服務，Lyft則與中國百度合作，準備進軍當地自駕車市場，使倫敦迅速成為全球自駕車業者競爭的新戰場。
Wayve的自駕系統稱為「AV2.0」，核心是以Embodied AI打造的AI Driver，透過大量實際駕駛經驗學習，而非高度依賴傳統高精度地圖、人工編寫規則或固定地理圍欄。Wayve表示，這種方法讓自駕系統能夠在面對不同道路、城市及交通環境時持續適應，目標是建立可以在不同地區及不同車款上運作的通用型自駕技術。
Wayve自2018年起就在倫敦道路訓練及測試AI技術，因此倫敦本身就是其自駕模型的重要訓練場。公司強調，倫敦擁有密集的行人、自行車騎士、複雜路口、圓環及不同道路設計，是測試自駕系統處理高度複雜城市交通能力的重要環境。
此次商業化服務並非突然出現。Uber與Wayve在2024年8月宣布建立多年合作關係，Uber同時對Wayve進行策略性投資，雙方計畫與汽車製造商合作，把Wayve的AI技術導入更多車輛，並最終將搭載Wayve技術的自駕車部署至Uber全球多個市場。當時Wayve剛完成10.5億美元Series C融資，Uber的投資進一步擴大其自駕車技術開發資金。
Wayve今年的融資規模也持續擴大。公司稍早完成約12億美元新一輪融資，投後估值達86億美元，投資者包括軟銀及其他科技與金融機構。這筆資金將用於推動自駕技術商業化及全球擴張，也凸顯投資人對「AI原生」自駕技術的高度期待。
Uber在2025年進一步宣布與Wayve合作，在英國啟動Level 4自動駕駛車公開道路測試，目標是最終實現不需要人類駕駛員介入的完全自動駕駛服務。當時雙方表示，倫敦將成為Uber推動大規模自駕車布局的重要起點，並希望把累積的道路數據及技術經驗帶往其他城市。
為了讓服務正式上線，倫敦交通局(TfL)在8月已向Wayve的部分自動駕駛全電動Ford Mustang Mach-E核發私人出租車輛牌照。這些車輛配備Wayve AI Driver以及環繞式攝影機和雷達，並接受TfL檢查，以確認符合當地政策及安全要求。
目前倫敦服務仍屬「有人監督的自動駕駛」，車內必須有持牌操作員，必要時可以接管車輛。這也是Uber與Wayve能夠先行推出商業服務、但尚未真正進入完全無人駕駛階段的關鍵原因。
倫敦的自駕車監管制度仍在形成。近期報導指出，TfL已允許部分自駕車在安全駕駛員陪同下進行載客，但針對完全無人駕駛載客服務的完整申請指引仍未全面到位。英國政府希望加快自駕車商業化，但監管機構仍強調必須以安全為優先，因此完全無人駕駛服務的正式時間表仍存在不確定性。
這也解釋了為何Uber此次選擇先推出有人監督的自駕服務。對Uber而言，這種模式可以讓乘客逐步熟悉自駕車，同時累積真實載客數據，並讓Wayve持續改善AI在倫敦複雜道路環境中的判斷能力，為未來移除車內安全操作員做準備。
Uber近年正大幅加速自駕車布局，策略並非自行開發單一自駕系統，而是與不同技術公司合作，把Uber的叫車網路、乘客及車隊管理能力與外部自駕技術結合。除了Wayve之外，Uber也已與其他自駕車業者合作，希望讓自駕車成為其叫車平台的重要車源。
倫敦因此成為全球機器人計程車產業的重要競爭市場。Waymo已準備進入倫敦，百度則與Lyft合作，意味著Uber、Wayve、Waymo及百度等業者將在英國首都直接競爭乘客、車輛部署及監管資源。
Uber選擇在倫敦率先擴大自駕服務，也具有戰略意義。與美國部分城市相比，倫敦道路環境更加複雜，左側行駛、狹窄街道、大量行人與自行車、雙層巴士及高度密集的城市交通，都讓自駕車面臨不同於美國高速公路及郊區道路的挑戰。
Wayve認為，其AI原生方法的優勢就在於不需要針對每一座城市建立大量固定規則及高精度地圖，而是讓模型透過實際駕駛經驗學習。公司此前曾展示同一套AI Driver在90天內穿越90座城市的能力，涵蓋歐洲、北美及日本不同道路環境。
對Uber而言，自駕車的商業價值也不只是降低駕駛成本。若未來完全無人駕駛能夠大規模商業化，Uber可以透過平台將自駕車與現有人工駕駛車隊混合調度，在尖峰及離峰時段根據需求調整車輛供給，進一步提高平台效率。
不過，自駕車大規模普及仍面臨安全、監管、責任歸屬及成本等問題。尤其完全無人駕駛一旦發生事故，究竟由自駕技術供應商、汽車製造商、車隊營運商或叫車平台負責，仍是全球監管機構及產業需要釐清的重要問題。
Uber與Wayve此次初期僅部署不到20輛車，也顯示倫敦目前仍處於市場驗證階段。若測試結果理想、監管進一步放寬，雙方未來可能擴大車隊規模，並將服務推向其他英國城市及海外市場。
根據Uber與Wayve先前公布的合作規劃，雙方最終希望把Wayve自駕車導入全球12個市場。這意味著倫敦並非單一城市試驗，而是兩家公司建立全球自駕車商業模式的重要第一步。
對Wayve來說，這次正式載客也代表從「自駕技術開發商」邁向實際商業營運的重要轉折；對Uber來說，則是把多年來與自駕車公司的合作及投資真正轉化為平台上的乘客服務。隨著Waymo及百度等競爭者陸續進場，倫敦能否成為歐洲機器人計程車產業的新核心，將取決於安全表現、監管開放速度以及消費者對無人駕駛的接受程度。
paras_en: Uber Technologies (UBER-US) and UK AI autonomous vehicle startup Wayve announced on Wednesday (Feb. 2) that they are officially launching an AI‑driven autonomous ride‑hailing service in London, making the city the second in Europe where Uber offers robotaxi services. The initial fleet is under 20 vehicles, each still equipped with a licensed safety operator on board; true fully driverless service will await further regulatory approval.

Uber says that London users can be matched for free to a fully electric Ford Mustang Mach‑E equipped with Wayve autonomous technology when they request UberX, Uber Comfort or Uber Electric via the app. If matched to a Wayve autonomous vehicle, users may accept the autonomous ride before the vehicle arrives or switch to a non‑autonomous vehicle; fares do not increase for riding an autonomous car.

This service marks the first time the UK offers autonomous ride‑hailing to the general public and lets Uber beat Alphabet’s Waymo to become the first company to launch commercial robotaxi service in London. Waymo had also planned to launch in London later this year, while Lyft is partnering with Chinese Baidu to enter the local autonomous market, turning London into a new battleground for autonomous vehicle competitors worldwide.

Wayve’s autonomous system, called AV2.0, centers on an AI Driver built with Embodied AI, learning from extensive real‑world driving experience rather than relying heavily on high‑definition maps, manually written rules, or fixed geofences. Wayve says this approach lets the system continuously adapt to different roads, cities, and traffic environments, aiming to create a universal autonomous technology that works across regions and vehicle models.

Since 2018, Wayve has been training and testing its AI on London roads, making the city a key training ground for its autonomous model. The company emphasizes that London’s dense pedestrian and cyclist traffic, complex junctions, roundabouts, and varied road designs provide a critical environment for testing the system’s ability to handle highly complex urban traffic.

The commercial service did not appear out of nowhere. Uber and Wayve announced a multi‑year partnership in August 2024, with Uber making a strategic investment in Wayve. The two plan to collaborate with automakers to integrate Wayve’s AI into more vehicles and ultimately deploy Wayve‑equipped autonomous cars across Uber’s global markets. At that time, Wayve had just closed a $1.05 billion Series C round, and Uber’s investment further expanded its autonomous vehicle technology funding.

Wayve’s funding has continued to grow this year. The company recently completed a new round of about $1.2 billion, bringing its post‑money valuation to $8.6 billion. Investors include SoftBank and other technology and financial institutions. The capital will be used to commercialize autonomous technology and expand globally, underscoring investors’ high expectations for “AI‑native” autonomous tech.

In 2025, Uber announced further collaboration with Wayve to launch Level 4 autonomous vehicle public road testing in the UK, aiming ultimately to achieve fully autonomous service without human driver intervention. The partners said London would be a key starting point for Uber’s large‑scale autonomous deployment and hoped to bring accumulated road data and technical experience to other cities.

To bring the service online, Transport for London (TfL) issued private hire vehicle licenses for some of Wayve’s autonomous electric Ford Mustang Mach‑Es in August. These vehicles are equipped with Wayve AI Driver, surround‑view cameras and radar, and have passed TfL inspections to confirm compliance with local policy and safety requirements.

London’s service remains “supervised autonomous” for now: a licensed operator must be inside the vehicle and can take over if necessary. This is the key reason Uber and Wayve can launch commercial service now but have not yet entered fully driverless operation.

London’s autonomous vehicle regulatory framework is still evolving. Recent reports indicate TfL has allowed some autonomous vehicles to carry passengers with a safety driver present, but comprehensive guidance for fully driverless passenger services is not yet fully in place. The UK government wants to accelerate commercial autonomous vehicle deployment, but regulators emphasize safety first, so a definitive timetable for fully driverless service remains uncertain.

This explains why Uber chose to launch a supervised autonomous service first. For Uber, this model lets passengers gradually become familiar with autonomous vehicles while accumulating real passenger data, and allows Wayve to continually improve AI decision‑making in London’s complex road environment in preparation for removing the in‑vehicle safety operator.

Uber has been rapidly accelerating its autonomous vehicle deployment in recent years, adopting a strategy of partnering with various tech companies rather than developing a single autonomous system in-house. In addition to Wayve, Uber has also partnered with other autonomous vehicle firms, hoping to make autonomous cars a key source for its ride‑hailing platform.

London has thus become a key competitive market for the global robotaxi industry. Waymo is ready to enter London, Baidu is partnering with Lyft, meaning Uber, Wayve, Waymo and Baidu will directly compete in the capital for passengers, vehicle deployment and regulatory resources.

Uber’s decision to expand autonomous services first in London has strategic significance. Compared to some US cities, London’s road environment is more complex, with left‑hand driving, narrow streets, heavy pedestrian and cyclist traffic, double‑decker buses and highly dense urban traffic, presenting challenges different from US highways and suburban roads.

Wayve believes the advantage of its AI‑native approach lies in not needing to build extensive fixed rules and high‑definition maps for each city, but instead letting the model learn from real driving experience. The company previously demonstrated that the same AI Driver could navigate 90 cities in 90 days, covering diverse road environments in Europe, North America and Japan.

For Uber, the commercial value of autonomous vehicles is not just about reducing driving costs. If fully driverless service can be mass‑commercialized in the future, Uber could use its platform to mix autonomous and human‑driven fleets, adjusting vehicle supply during peak and off‑peak times to further improve platform efficiency.

However, large‑scale adoption of autonomous vehicles still faces safety, regulatory, liability and cost challenges. In particular, when a fully driverless vehicle is involved in an accident, determining whether the autonomous technology provider, automaker, fleet operator or ride‑hailing platform is responsible remains a key issue that regulators and industry must clarify worldwide.

Uber and Wayve’s initial deployment of fewer than 20 vehicles also shows that London is still in a market‑validation phase. If test results are favorable and regulation eases further, the two may expand the fleet and roll out the service to other UK cities and overseas markets.

According to Uber and Wayve’s previously announced partnership plan, the two ultimately aim to deploy Wayve autonomous vehicles in 12 global markets. This means London is not just a single‑city experiment but an important first step in building a global autonomous vehicle business model for the two companies.

For Wayve, this formal passenger service marks a significant transition from “autonomous technology developer” to actual commercial operations; for Uber, it turns years of collaboration and investment with autonomous vehicle companies into real passenger service on its platform. As competitors like Waymo and Baidu enter the market, whether London becomes the new European robotaxi hub will depend on safety performance, regulatory openness and consumer acceptance of driverless vehicles.

items.title: SpaceX的AI優勢有多大？分析師看好股價翻倍
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，分析師認為，SpaceX(SPCX-US)的AI部門正快速成長，在一項關鍵資源持續短缺之際，這將為公司帶來巨大優勢。
AI產業對運算能力的需求十分龐大，企業需要大量算力來訓練及運行模型。根據PwC最新報告，為了建置AI所需的運算能力，企業預計到2050年將投入36.1兆美元，主要用於投資資料中心及相關技術。
Oppenheimer分析師Timothy Horan在周三(2日)給客戶的報告中表示，SpaceX有望成為短期算力供應短缺下的贏家。Horan認為，SpaceX「有能力以比任何其他公司更快的速度擴充基礎設施，並利用這些基礎設施及取得的數據，以更快的速度改善自身模型」。
Horan給予SpaceX股票「買進」評級，並將目標價從250美元上調至280美元。新的目標價意味著SpaceX股價較目前水準約有100%上漲空間。
SpaceX計劃將運算能力從目前的1.4GW擴增至2026年底的逾2GW。馬斯克在財報電話會議上表示，SpaceX目標是在2027年底前，讓運算能力「更接近10GW，而不是5GW」。他並補充，公司希望屆時擁有20GW的電力與冷卻能力。
根據瑞穗，要達成SpaceX 2027年的算力目標，可能需要投入3,000億至5,000億美元。這可能迫使公司進一步舉債。摩根士丹利分析師Adam Jonas表示，SpaceX到2035年平均每年需要新增800億美元淨負債。看好SpaceX的Jonas在給客戶的報告中指出，SpaceX今年預計將投入530億美元於AI。
SpaceX認為這些投資將帶來回報。SpaceX財務長Bret Johnsen上個月告訴投資人，公司從建置AI運算能力所投入的資金，可以在不到一年內回收。
這主要得益於與Alphabet、Anthropic及至少另外兩家客戶簽訂的算力租賃合約。這些合約將在未來數年為SpaceX帶來數百億美元營收，不過Alphabet與Anthropic的合約都允許雙方提前終止合作。
Horan表示，「在算力持續緊張的環境下，我們預期SPCX能夠取得Anthropic等合作夥伴利用SpaceX算力所創造營收的每1美元中的50%。」
除了出租算力之外，SpaceX也利用自身資源訓練旗下AI模型Grok。公司近期也完成對AI新創Cursor的收購，Horan形容這項收購具「轉型性」作用，有助於SpaceX開發模型並創造額外營收。
周二在Anthropic發布最新AI模型後不久，馬斯克表示SpaceX將在10天後推出最新版本Grok 4.7。SpaceX不到一個月前才發布Grok 4.6，根據Artificial Analysis，該模型具備強大的能力，且成本低於部分領先AI模型。

items.title: 雀巢瘦身計畫加速 10億美元打包出售7個保健品品牌
items.title_en: Nestlé Accelerates Slim‑Down Plan, $1 Billion Deal to Sell Seven Health‑Supplement Brands
paras: 全球最大食品飲料公司雀巢瘦身進程再添新動作，雀巢2日（周三）宣布以10億美元的代價，出售旗下主流維生素、礦物質和補充劑（VMS）業務，涉及7個品牌。
公告顯示，本次交易涉及七大成熟品牌：Nature's Bounty、Osteo Bi-Flex、Ester-C、Gard、Nuun、Puritan's Pride和Sisu，以及相關美國自有品牌補充劑業務，還包括專屬製造、包裝、倉儲和配送營運設施。
交易需獲監管機關批准，預計將於2027年上半年完成。接手方為Yellow Wood Partners，其是一家總部位於美國波士頓、專注於消費行業的私募股權公司。
其核心業務模式是收購大型跨國公司不再重點發展的消費品牌，透過專業營運進行改造和增值。
雀巢執行長費耐睿（Philipp Navratil）表示，此次出售是雀巢投資組合策略轉型又一關鍵步驟，目的是將資源更加集中於高檔和科學主導的業務領域。
值得注意的是，這筆交易並非突發決策。雀巢早在2026年上半年財報中，就已將該大眾維生素業務與冰淇淋業務一同劃為「待售資產」，並針對這批資產計提了約13億瑞士法郎非現金減值。
受這筆減值及相關重組費用影響，雀巢2026年上半年淨利潤較一年前銳減31.4%，降至35億瑞士法郎。
資料顯示，Nature's Bounty等品牌是雀巢在2021年收購Bountiful公司後納入麾下，此番均在出售之列。
不過，雀巢保留了Bountiful公司旗下核心保健品品牌Solgar，以及2017年收購的低過敏性高檔保健品品牌Pure Encapsulations。
2026年以來，雀巢正加速「斷捨離」。2月19日，雀巢在公布2025年財報時宣布，正就出售剩餘冰淇淋業務與合資夥伴Froneri公司展開深入談判。該業務估值接近10億瑞士法郎。雀巢計劃在未來一年內將這些品牌出售給Froneri。
今年4月，雀巢在發布第一季財報時宣布，已同意將藍瓶咖啡（Blue Bottle Coffee）出售給大鉦資本。同時，大眾維生素、礦物質和補充劑（VMS）業務也已被劃入「待出售資產」。
paras_en: Nestlé, the world’s largest food‑and‑beverage company, took another step in its slimming process on Wednesday, announcing a $1 billion sale of its mainstream vitamins, minerals and supplements (VMS) business, covering seven brands.

The announcement details that the deal involves seven mature brands – Nature’s Bounty, Osteo Bi‑Flex, Ester‑C, Gard, Nuun, Puritan’s Pride and Sisu – together with Nestlé’s U.S. private‑label supplement business, as well as dedicated manufacturing, packaging, warehousing and distribution facilities.

The transaction is subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in the first half of 2027. The buyer is Yellow Wood Partners, a private‑equity firm based in Boston that focuses on the consumer sector.
Its core model is to acquire consumer brands that large multinationals are no longer prioritising, then revamp and add value through professional operations.
Nestlé CEO Philipp Navratil said the sale is another key step in the company’s portfolio‑transformation strategy, aimed at concentrating resources on premium and science‑driven business areas.

It is worth noting that the deal was not a sudden decision. Nestlé had already flagged the mass‑market vitamin business as a “sale‑ready asset” together with its ice‑cream business in its H1 2026 earnings report, recording a non‑cash impairment of about 1.3 billion Swiss francs for those assets.
Because of that impairment and related restructuring costs, Nestlé’s net profit for the first half of 2026 fell 31.4% year‑on‑year to 3.5 billion Swiss francs.
Data show that brands such as Nature’s Bounty were brought under Nestlé’s umbrella after the 2021 acquisition of Bountiful, and all of them are now slated for sale.
However, Nestlé will retain the core health‑supplement brand Solgar from Bountiful, as well as the premium, low‑allergy brand Pure Encapsulations, which it acquired in 2017.

Since 2026, Nestlé has been accelerating its “cut‑and‑sell” strategy. On February 19, while releasing its 2025 results, the company announced deepening talks with joint‑venture partner Froneri on selling the remaining ice‑cream business, valued at roughly 10 billion Swiss francs, with plans to divest those brands to Froneri within the next year.

In April this year, Nestlé disclosed in its Q1 earnings release that it had agreed to sell Blue Bottle Coffee to DCM Capital, and that the mass‑market vitamins, minerals and supplements (VMS) business had also been classified as a “sale‑ready asset.”

items.title: 雪佛龍宣布未來五年投資70億美元 委內瑞拉石油產量翻倍
items.title_en: Chevron Announces $7 B Investment Over Five Years, Plans to Double Venezuela Oil Production
paras: 美國石油巨頭雪佛龍(CVX-US) 周三（2日）宣布，將投資超過70億美元，計劃未來五年內將其在委內瑞拉的原油產量翻番至約60萬桶/日，進一步擴大在當地業務布局。
就在幾天前，美國總統川普宣布，他達成了一筆「世界史上最大石油交易」：美國正聯合私營企業取得委內瑞拉650億桶探明石油儲量的控制權。
雪佛龍是目前唯一一家在委內瑞拉擁有大規模業務布局的美國石油公司。雪佛龍周三表示，已獲得委內瑞拉奧里諾科重油帶的新增區塊，此前雪佛龍已在該地區建立穩固業務基礎。
根據雙方合資計畫，雪佛龍將在未來五年投資超過70億美元，預計石油產量將較2026年翻一倍以上，增至約60萬桶/日。
委內瑞拉擁有全球最大已探明石油儲量，總量超過3,030億桶。但多年來管理不善、腐敗、投資不足以及美國制裁，委內瑞拉石油產業遭嚴重削弱。
委內瑞拉石油產量在上世紀90年代末曾達到逾300萬桶/日峰值，此後大幅下滑。近幾個月來，委內瑞拉產量一直維持在110萬至120萬桶/日左右。
此次新增區塊以及更加優惠的經營條件，將進一步擴大雪佛龍在委內瑞拉的業務版圖。近期雪佛龍在委內瑞拉的原油產量約29萬桶/日，且全部出口至美國。
川普今年1月抓捕委內瑞拉總統馬杜洛後，一直推動一項規模達1,000億美元的委內瑞拉能源產業重建計畫，並敦促美國石油企業投資委內瑞拉。
paras_en: U.S. oil giant Chevron (CVX-US) announced on Wednesday the 2nd that it will invest more than $7 billion to double its crude oil output in Venezuela to about 600,000 barrels per day over the next five years, further expanding its local footprint.

Just days earlier, U.S. President Trump declared he had secured a "world‑record oil deal": the United States, together with private firms, would gain control of Venezuela’s 650 billion‑barrel proven oil reserves.

Chevron is currently the only U.S. oil company with a large‑scale presence in Venezuela. On Wednesday the company said it had been awarded new blocks in the Orinoco heavy‑oil belt, building on an already solid base in the region.

Under the joint‑venture plan, Chevron will pour more than $7 billion into the project over the next five years, with oil production expected to more than double its 2026 level to roughly 600,000 barrels per day.

Venezuela holds the world’s largest proven oil reserves, exceeding 303 billion barrels, but years of mismanagement, corruption, under‑investment and U.S. sanctions have severely weakened its oil sector.
Venezuela’s oil output peaked at over 3 million barrels per day in the late 1990s before plunging sharply; in recent months production has hovered around 1.1‑1.2 million barrels per day.

The new blocks and more favorable operating terms will further expand Chevron’s footprint in Venezuela. Currently the company produces about 290,000 barrels per day of crude there, all of which is exported to the United States.

Since President Trump’s January arrest of Venezuelan President Maduro, he has been pushing a $100 billion plan to rebuild Venezuela’s energy industry and urging U.S. oil firms to invest in the country.

items.title: 博通財報優、AI營收強勁 為何仍一度重挫5%？
items.title_en: Broadcom's Strong Earnings and AI Revenue Yet Stock Slid 5% at One Point—Why?
paras: 《Yhaoo Finance》報導，博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)股價周三(2日)盤後一度重挫5%，隨後跌幅收斂。
這家AI晶片與網路設備大廠受惠於強勁的AI需求，營收持續成長，但財報表現仍不足以推動股價上漲。財報公布後，博通股價立即下挫，之後跌幅逐步收斂。
StoneX金融股票研究分析師Cody Acree表示，「我可以理解市場賣壓。」Acree給予博通股票「買進」評級，但他指出，這家晶片大廠第三季營收與獲利優於預期「仍不足以讓投資人滿意」。
Acree表示，「從營收與獲利表現來看，這次財報優於預期並上修財測的幅度，還不夠大。畢竟這是一家高度受惠於AI的公司。」
博通調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為3.32美元，高於華爾街預期的3.23美元。單季營收年增86%至296億美元，也優於市場預期的294.5億美元。
博通表示，第三季AI半導體營收達167億美元，年增221%，季增54%。
博通預估，目前一季(第四季)營收將達348億美元，低於彭博數據所統計分析師預期的350.5億美元。
隨著科技巨頭競相開發客製化晶片並擴建資料中心，博通營收大幅成長。
博通執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)在財報新聞稿中表示，「市場對我們客製化AI加速器與網路產品的需求持續非常強勁。」
博通股價今年以來上漲6%，相較之下，同業輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)上漲20%。
Acree表示，「就資料中心整體生態系而言，博通真的只落後於輝達。」他指出，「現在只是在於何時進場，以及如何因應持有部位進行交易。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Broadcom (AVGO-US) shares fell as much as 5% after hours on Wednesday (the 2nd), before the decline narrowed.

The AI chip and networking equipment giant has benefited from robust AI demand, with revenue continuing to grow, but its earnings report was not enough to lift the stock. After the results were released, Broadcom’s share price dropped immediately, then the loss gradually narrowed.

StoneX financial equity research analyst Cody Acree said, "I can understand the market’s selling pressure." Acree gave Broadcom a "Buy" rating, but noted that the chip maker’s third‑quarter revenue and profit, while better than expected, "still aren’t enough to satisfy investors."
Acree added, "Looking at revenue and profit performance, the beat and the upward revision of forecasts this time aren’t large enough. After all, this is a company that is heavily benefiting from AI."

Broadcom reported adjusted earnings per share of $3.32, above Wall Street’s expectation of $3.23. Quarterly revenue rose 86% year‑over‑year to $29.6 billion, also beating the market forecast of $29.45 billion.
Broadcom said AI semiconductor revenue for the third quarter reached $16.7 billion, up 221% year‑over‑year and 54% sequentially.
Broadcom forecasts that current quarter (fourth quarter) revenue will be $34.8 billion, below Bloomberg’s consensus estimate of $35.05 billion from analysts.
As tech giants race to develop custom chips and expand data centers, Broadcom’s revenue has surged dramatically.
Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said in the earnings press release, "Demand for our custom AI accelerators and networking products remains very strong in the market."
Broadcom’s stock is up 6% year‑to‑date, compared with peers Nvidia (NVDA-US), which is up about 20%.
Acree said, "In the overall data‑center ecosystem, Broadcom really is only behind Nvidia." He added, "The question now is timing of entry and how to manage positions once you hold them."

items.title: 全球長債重定價風向球！日本今發行30年國債 分析師：若需求愈冷恐加劇全球債市拋售
items.title_en: Global Long‑Term Bond Repricing Indicator: Japan Issues 30‑Year Treasury Today – Analysts Warn Demand Warming Could Trigger Global Bond Sell‑off
paras: 日本今(3)日舉行30年期國債拍賣，時間點恰逢全球長端利率飆至近20年高點，日本10年期國債殖利率衝破3%，10年期美債刺破4.8%、日德澳三國公債殖利率也創下多年新高，此次標售被交易員視為檢驗超長債需求的「全球試金石」。
拍賣前，日本30年國債殖利率回落10個基點至4.065%，脫離1999年該期限問世以來峰值，美債週三(2日)亦隨油價回檔而小幅上漲。
不過，市場不敢鬆懈。本週10年債招標雖平穩，30年債對財政擔憂與供需更敏感。
巴克萊策略師Ayao Ehara預估日本長債拍賣結果疲軟或平淡，並稱「當前殖利率與長期公允價值相近，但日相高市早苗擴張性財政議程、下財年預算申請創紀錄，仍構成明確拖累」。
道明證券分析師Prashant Newnaha亦示警，日債曾是全球固收資產的支柱，現在情況變了。若發債遇冷，賣壓外溢將推動全球固收資產重新定價，並讓美國壓抑長端美債的努力更複雜，30年國債殖利率上行還會把市場焦點從貨幣政策拉回財政，而每年債務的努力更為複雜。
不過，日本壽險等國內資金買盤與歷史4%附近認購倍數提供一定支撐力道，但在全球拋售長債壓力下，都可能放大「財政風險溢價」。這場拍賣不再只是日本的事，而是全球長債重定價的風向球。
paras_en: Japan held a 30‑year Treasury auction today, timed to coincide with long‑term rates worldwide hitting a near‑20‑year high. The 10‑year Japanese yield surpassed 3%, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury broke 4.8%, and yields on Japanese, German and Australian sovereigns all set multi‑year highs, making this auction a “global touchstone” for ultra‑long bond demand.

Before the auction, the 30‑year Japanese yield had fallen 10 basis points to 4.065%, easing from the peak reached since the instrument’s inception in 1999, while U.S. Treasury yields on Wednesday also edged up slightly as oil prices fell.
However, the market remains cautious. This week’s 10‑year Treasury auction was steady, but the 30‑year bond is more sensitive to fiscal concerns and supply‑demand dynamics.

Bank of England strategist Ayao Ehara predicts a weak or flat outcome for Japan’s long‑bond auction, noting that “current yields are close to long‑term fair value, but Japan’s expansive fiscal agenda and record‑high budget requests for the next fiscal year still pose a clear drag.”

Morgan Stanley analyst Prashant Newnaha also warned that Japan’s bonds once formed the backbone of global fixed‑income assets, but the situation has changed. A cold issuance could spill selling pressure into global fixed‑income markets, complicating U.S. efforts to tame long‑term yields, and a rise in 30‑year yields would shift market focus from monetary policy back to fiscal policy, making annual debt management more complex.

Nonetheless, domestic investors such as Japanese life insurers and the historical 4% subscription multiple provide some support, but under global long‑bond sell‑off pressure, they could amplify a “fiscal risk premium.” This auction is no longer just a Japanese issue; it is a global long‑bond repricing barometer.

items.title: 德國機場無人機襲擊未遂事件 德方：受俄羅斯指使
items.title_en: Germany Airport Drone Attack Foiled, Germany Says It Was Directed by Russia
paras: 歐盟外交與安全政策高級代表卡拉斯2日（周三）表示，歐盟已就德國萊比錫機場無人機襲擊未遂事件召見俄羅斯駐歐盟大使，她稱這起事件具國家支持恐怖主義的所有特徵。
卡拉斯2日說，歐盟各國外長將討論目前正在推進的工作，即制裁與俄羅斯軍事工業相關1,600個個人和實體。
據《法新社》報導，法國外長巴羅2日在歐盟成員國外長非正式會議期間說，法方已召見俄羅斯駐法國大使館臨時代辦，並提出抗議。
德國警方8月5日在萊比錫機場一架烏克蘭運輸機附近發現並控制一架無人機，無人機上據稱裝有帶引信的爆炸物。
據德國《世界報》9月1日報導，根據聯邦政府的調查結果，未遂爆炸無人機襲擊事件是受俄羅斯指使。
德國外長瓦德富爾當天宣布，將於9月18日關閉俄羅斯駐波恩總領事館。此外，德國還將終止與柏林「俄羅斯之家」的合約，並召見俄羅斯駐德國大使。
據俄羅斯《消息報》1日報導，俄羅斯駐德國大使涅恰耶夫表示，德國對俄羅斯的指控毫無根據，荒謬絕倫，違背常理。
俄羅斯宣布，將對德國的懲罰性措施作出對等回應。俄羅斯外交部發言人扎哈羅娃1日表示，將對德國關閉俄駐波恩總領事館作出回應。
paras_en: EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell said on Wednesday that the EU has summoned the Russian ambassador to the EU over the foiled drone attack at Leipzig Airport, describing the incident as having all the hallmarks of state‑sponsored terrorism.
Borrell added that EU foreign ministers will discuss ongoing work to sanction 1,600 individuals and entities linked to Russia’s military‑industrial complex.

According to AFP, French Foreign Minister Stéphane Barrois said during an informal meeting of EU foreign ministers that France has summoned the chargé d'affaires of the Russian embassy in France to lodge a protest.
German police on August 5 discovered and secured a drone near a Ukrainian transport aircraft at Leipzig Airport, which was reportedly equipped with a bomb fitted with a fuse.
The German newspaper Die Welt reported on September 1 that, based on the federal government’s investigation, the attempted drone bombing was directed by Russia.

German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock announced that the Russian consulate general in Bonn will be closed on September 18, and that Germany will also terminate its contract with the Berlin “Russian House” and summon the Russian ambassador to Germany.
Russia’s Izvestia newspaper quoted Russian ambassador to Germany Nikolay Nechayev on the 1st, saying Germany’s accusations are baseless, absurd and contrary to reason.

Russia said it will respond in kind to Germany’s punitive measures, with Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zahharova stating on the 1st that Russia will react to Germany’s closure of the Russian consulate in Bonn.

items.title: 台積電憑什麼牢牢抓住蘋果？英特爾最難追的不是製程
items.title_en: How TSMC Keeps a Firm Grip on Apple: The Hardest Thing for Intel to Catch Up Is Not the Process
paras: 《AppleInsider》引述半導體研究機構《Culpium》報導，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 能長期穩居蘋果 (AAPL-US) 核心晶片供應商，靠的不只是先進製程與量產能力，更重要的是數十年累積的客戶信任。英特爾 (INTC-US) 即使重新取得蘋果部分晶片業務，仍難以複製雙方的合作關係。
蘋果2020年開始讓Mac告別英特爾處理器，全面轉向自行設計的Apple Silicon，並由台積電負責製造。這項轉變為蘋果帶來更高的軟硬體整合能力，也讓台積電進一步鞏固在蘋果供應鏈中的地位。
儘管美國總統川普今年6月宣布，蘋果已同意與英特爾合作，在美國生產部分晶片，但這並不代表蘋果重回英特爾懷抱。英特爾目前面臨的核心問題，也不只是製程技術能否追上台積電，而是能否讓蘋果相信其具備足夠產能、穩定交付能力與保密意識。
台積電不與客戶競爭 先取得蘋果信任
蘋果早年曾邀請英特爾生產行動裝置處理器，但遭到拒絕，之後改由三星電子供應。然而，三星既是晶片供應商，也是蘋果在消費電子市場的競爭對手，加上三星參與Google母公司Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 的Android生態系，使時任蘋果執行長賈伯斯對其有所顧慮。
台積電的商業模式正好解決了這項問題。台積電專注替客戶製造晶片，不推出與客戶競爭的自有品牌處理器，因此得以在合作過程中保持中立。台積電先後服務輝達 (NVDA-US)、高通 (QCOM-US) 等晶片設計公司，也逐步證明自己能夠保護客戶技術與商業機密。
2010年底，鴻海 (2317-TW) 創辦人郭台銘安排台積電創辦人張忠謀與蘋果營運主管傑夫·威廉斯 (Jeff Williams) 會面。威廉斯當時提出，希望台積電成為蘋果的晶片代工商，甚至承接蘋果全部訂單。
雙方經過數月談判後，蘋果一度暫停合作計畫，轉而評估英特爾的代工能力。張忠謀當時並未感到憂心，因為他認為，蘋果選擇供應商時重視的三項條件，分別是技術、製造能力與信任，而英特爾在這些方面並未優於台積電。
2011年3月，當時擔任蘋果代理執行長的庫克向張忠謀表示，英特爾不知道該如何經營晶圓代工業務。這也讓張忠謀更加確信，台積電真正的優勢不只是生產晶片，而是懂得如何服務客戶。
英特爾陷入先有訂單、還是先擴產的困局
英特爾近年積極發展晶圓代工業務，希望重新爭取蘋果等大型客戶，但財務與產能策略卻形成阻礙。
陳立武2025年3月接掌英特爾後，強調公司不能再無限制投入資金，因而放慢俄亥俄州晶圓廠建設進度，並取消原訂在德國與波蘭興建工廠的計畫。英特爾也不願在客戶正式承諾下單前，提前建置大量產能。
問題在於，蘋果等大型客戶同樣不願在英特爾證明產能及交付能力前交出訂單。英特爾希望先取得訂單再擴產，客戶卻要求先看到產能才願意下單，使英特爾陷入難以突破的兩難。
儘管如此，在白宮推動晶片美國製造的政策壓力下，英特爾仍持續爭取外部客戶，並成功與Alphabet、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 及輝達展開合作。
爭取蘋果訂單 卻踩中保密紅線
除了產能疑慮，英特爾在爭取蘋果訂單時還犯下保密失誤。
英特爾曾為了向蘋果證明公司能迅速增加產能，透露已與設備供應商討論採購事宜。然而，英特爾在相關談判中宣稱蘋果已是其客戶，並以此要求設備供應商優先供貨。
這項做法直接踩到蘋果高度重視的保密紅線。英特爾不僅在合作尚未正式確定前使用蘋果名義爭取設備，還主動向蘋果透露此事，反而證明公司未必能妥善保護客戶資訊。
技術與產能可以投資 信任只能長期累積
受到當前半導體產業供需與美國製造布局影響，蘋果仍選擇與英特爾合作，但雙方關係與蘋果、台積電之間的長期夥伴模式仍有明顯差距。
台積電多年來對客戶身分與合作內容保持低調，同時堅持不與客戶競爭。這套經營模式讓台積電能持續承接蘋果訂單，也使信任成為其他晶圓代工業者難以跨越的門檻。
台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家今年7月向投資人表示，技術研發與製造產能固然重要，但信任無法像到便利商店購買牛奶一樣，隨時都能取得。對英特爾而言，製程與產能仍可透過投資改善，但要重新取得蘋果信任，顯然需要更長時間。
paras_en: AppleInsider, citing semiconductor research firm Culpium, reports that TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) can remain Apple’s (AAPL‑US) core chip supplier for the long term not only because of its advanced processes and mass‑production capability, but more importantly due to decades of accumulated customer trust. Even if Intel (INTC‑US) regains some of Apple’s chip business, it will still struggle to replicate the partnership.

Apple began phasing Intel processors out of Macs in 2020, moving entirely to its own Apple Silicon designs manufactured by TSMC. The shift gave Apple tighter hardware‑software integration and further cemented TSMC’s position in Apple’s supply chain.

Although President Trump announced in June that Apple had agreed to work with Intel to produce some chips in the United States, this does not mean Apple is returning to Intel’s embrace. Intel’s core challenge is not merely catching TSMC’s process technology, but convincing Apple that it has sufficient capacity, reliable delivery and strong confidentiality.
TSMC Does Not Compete With Customers – First Gaining Apple’s Trust

Apple once invited Intel to produce mobile‑device processors, but Intel declined and Apple turned to Samsung. Samsung, however, is both a chip supplier and a competitor to Apple in consumer electronics, and its involvement in Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) Android ecosystem gave then‑CEO Steve Jobs cause for concern.

TSMC’s business model solves that dilemma. It focuses solely on manufacturing chips for customers and does not sell its own competing processors, allowing it to stay neutral. TSMC has served companies such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US), gradually proving its ability to protect customers’ technology and commercial secrets.

At the end of 2010, Foxconn founder Terry Gou arranged a meeting between TSMC founder Morris Chang and Apple operations chief Jeff Williams. Williams then asked TSMC to become Apple’s chip foundry and even to take all of Apple’s orders.

After months of talks, Apple briefly paused the project to evaluate Intel’s foundry capability. Chang was not worried, believing Apple values three criteria when choosing a supplier – technology, manufacturing capability and trust – and Intel did not surpass TSMC on any of them.

In March 2011, then‑Apple CEO Tim Cook told Chang that Intel did not know how to run a wafer‑foundry business. This reinforced Chang’s belief that TSMC’s advantage lies not only in chip production but in understanding how to serve customers.
Intel Caught in the Catch‑22 of Orders Versus Capacity Expansion
In recent years Intel has pushed hard into wafer‑foundry services to win back large customers like Apple, but its financial and capacity strategies have become obstacles.

After Chen Liwu took over Intel in March 2025, he stressed that the company could no longer pour unlimited money into expansion, slowing construction of the Ohio fab and scrapping plans for factories in Germany and Poland. Intel also refuses to build large capacity before customers formally commit orders.

The problem is that big customers such as Apple also refuse to place orders before Intel proves its capacity and delivery reliability. Intel wants orders first and then to scale up; customers want capacity first, putting Intel in a dead‑end dilemma.
Nevertheless, under White House pressure to “Make Chips in America,” Intel continues to chase external customers and has secured deals with Alphabet, Tesla (TSLA‑US) and Nvidia.
Chasing Apple’s Order Yet Tripping Over Confidentiality Rules
Beyond capacity concerns, Intel made a confidentiality slip while pursuing Apple’s business.
To demonstrate rapid capacity expansion, Intel disclosed that it had discussed equipment purchases with suppliers, even claiming Apple was already a customer to secure priority supply.

That move crossed Apple’s strict confidentiality line. Intel not only used Apple’s name before any formal agreement but also informed Apple of the claim, showing it might not safeguard client information properly.
Technology and Capacity Can Be Invested in; Trust Must Be Built Over Time

Affected by current semiconductor supply‑demand dynamics and U.S. manufacturing policies, Apple still chooses to work with Intel, but the relationship remains far from the long‑term partnership Apple enjoys with TSMC.

TSMC has long kept customer identities and deal details low‑key while steadfastly refusing to compete with them. This model lets TSMC continuously win Apple orders and makes trust a barrier other foundries find hard to cross.

Wei Zhejia, TSMC’s chairman and CEO, told investors in July that while R&D and manufacturing capacity are important, trust cannot be bought off a convenience‑store shelf. For Intel, process technology and capacity can be improved with investment, but regaining Apple’s trust will clearly take much longer.

items.title: 韓國半導體8月出口暴增209%創新高 AI熱潮撐起近半出口「好得過頭」？
items.title_en: South Korea’s Semiconductor Exports Surge 209% in August to Record High, AI Boom Fuels Nearly Half of Exports – Is It Too Much?
paras: 韓國半導體出口8月再創歷史新高，年增209%至466.5億美元，幾乎是去年同期的3倍，並占當月商品出口總額982.5億美元的47.5%，強勁的AI基礎設施需求推動韓國出口連續第3個月站上900億美元。不過，半導體出口成長速度過於猛烈，也讓市場開始擔心，一旦AI投資熱潮降溫，韓國經濟是否有足夠的其他產業接棒。
韓國產業通商資源部9月1日公布數據顯示，8月出口年增68.7%至982.5億美元，創歷來第3高紀錄，僅次於6月的1,020億美元及7月的990億美元；進口則年增22.5%至635.1億美元，貿易順差達347.5億美元，連續第3個月突破300億美元。經工作日調整後，韓國8月日均出口達44.7億美元，年增72.5%，連續第4個月超過40億美元。
半導體無疑是這波出口狂潮的核心。8月半導體出口達466.5億美元，較去年同期暴增209%，刷新6月448億美元的前高紀錄，也是韓國半導體出口連續第3個月突破400億美元。韓國政府指出，主要推力來自大型雲端服務商持續擴大AI基礎設施資本支出，包括Alphabet旗下Google (GOOGL-US)及Amazon (AMZN-US)等超大規模雲端業者均持續投入AI資料中心與運算基礎設施。
韓國半導體業者也正直接受惠於AI伺服器需求。SK hynix (SKHY-US)今年7月在美國Nasdaq掛牌ADR，並以SKHY為交易代碼，成為全球AI記憶體需求熱潮下最受矚目的韓國企業之一。SK hynix在高頻寬記憶體(HBM)市場占據領先地位，而近期強勁的AI投資也持續推升記憶體價格與需求。
除了半導體之外，韓國出口結構也出現一定程度改善。8月非半導體出口年增20%，20大主要出口品項中有14項成長。電腦出口暴增419.5%至62.4億美元，創單月歷史新高，主要受企業級SSD核心零組件NAND價格持續上漲帶動；無線通訊設備出口則年增21.2%至18.8億美元，受Galaxy S26、Z Fold 8及Z Flip 8等新產品銷售帶動，已連續10個月維持成長。
記憶體價格上升也成為出口金額快速膨脹的重要因素。韓國政府數據顯示，DDR5 16Gb固定價格從4月的35美元一路升至8月的46.5美元；NAND 128Gb價格則從4月的24.2美元升至8月的30.5美元。這代表即使出貨量沒有以同等速度增加，價格上漲本身也會推高出口金額。
從地區來看，韓國8月出口呈現明顯的科技業帶動格局。對美國出口年增89.3%，對中國出口更大增119.3%，對東協出口則增加75.4%；但對中東出口下滑15%，顯示不同產業及市場之間的復甦速度並不一致。
這也正是經濟學家開始提醒「好得過頭」的原因。Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation亞洲總體策略主管Jeff Ng指出，他估計8月出口增長中接近80%來自半導體，整體出口成長主要由晶片、電腦及石油產品價格上漲推動。
Moody"s Analytics經濟學家Dave Chia則認為，如果半導體景氣只是逐步放緩，韓國經濟應該仍能應付，但如果出口突然停滯，情況就會截然不同。韓國經濟目前呈現「兩種速度」運行，半導體與科技產業快速擴張，但其他需要承接成長動能的產業反而正承受壓力。
汽車產業就是其中一個例子。韓國8月汽車出口年減29.8%至38.5億美元，主要受到主要車廠將今年暑休從去年7月底移至今年8月初的基期因素，以及部分罷工造成生產中斷影響。船舶出口也因交付量減少而下滑45.9%至16.9億美元。
不過，汽車出口下滑並非全部屬於結構性問題。除了休假時點及罷工等短期因素外，Moody"s Analytics也指出，美國關稅政策以及車廠逐步將生產移往美國的趨勢，可能對韓國汽車出口形成更持久的壓力。
韓國其他傳統產業也受到全球能源價格及供應環境影響。8月石油產品出口年增65.3%至68.4億美元，石化產品出口增加12.2%至38.6億美元，主要因荷姆茲海峽通行風險推升國際油價，使出口單價維持高檔。不過，石油產品出口量反而下降2.2%，石化產品出口量也下滑7%，顯示這部分出口金額成長相當程度來自價格因素。
另一方面，韓國二次電池出口8月達6億美元，年增24%，已連續4個月成長，主要受鋰等礦產價格回升、電動車新產品訂單增加，以及儲能系統(ESS)市場活躍帶動。這意味著除半導體之外，部分高科技出口領域也正在改善。
韓國央行(BOK)的貨幣政策也可能成為下一階段經濟表現的重要變數。韓國央行8月將基準利率上調25個基點至3%，為連續第2次升息，原因之一是核心通膨仍處相對高檔。近期韓國經濟雖受出口強勁帶動，但利率偏高可能限制內需進一步擴張。
Chia警告，如果晶片需求開始降溫，但韓國央行仍處於緊縮政策階段，出口帶來的「意外之財」可能消退，而國內需求又不足以填補缺口，經濟成長將面臨更大的壓力。
不過，韓國央行在8月貨幣政策決議中也指出，消費復甦正逐步加速，加上8月非半導體出口仍成長20%，顯示韓國經濟並非完全依賴晶片出口。韓國政府同樣認為，非半導體品項出現20%左右的成長，代表出口成長基礎正在擴大。
Lombard Odier資深總體策略師Homin Lee表示，如果半導體出口動能逐步減弱，同時其他景氣循環產業維持良好表現，韓國仍有機會維持約2%至3%的全年實質經濟成長。
市場目前也沒有預期韓國半導體出口會立即反轉。SMBC的Ng預期，未來12個月韓國整體出口仍將維持正成長，只是隨著去年高基期效應出現，以及商品價格逐步穩定，出口年增率可能較目前水準放緩。
韓國半導體與科技出口的這波成長確實異常強勁，但Lombard Odier的Lee並不認為這已構成所謂的「過度依賴」。他指出，韓國仍擁有汽車、造船、化工及其他景氣循環產業，這些產業通常會在全球經濟同步擴張時受益。因此，真正的關鍵並非半導體出口是否會永遠維持超高速成長，而是當AI晶片熱潮從高峰逐步正常化後，其他產業能否及時接棒。
最新數據也顯示，韓國出口目前仍處於罕見的強勢階段。8月總出口連續第3個月突破900億美元，半導體單月出口則刷新歷史紀錄；但隨著半導體在出口中的占比逼近一半，AI資本支出、記憶體價格及全球科技景氣一旦出現轉折，對韓國整體經濟的傳導效應也將比過去更加直接。
paras_en: South Korea’s semiconductor exports reached a new historical high in August, rising 209% year‑on‑year to $46.65 billion, almost three times the same period last year, and accounting for 47.5% of the month’s total goods exports of $98.25 billion. The strong demand for AI infrastructure has pushed Korea’s exports above $90 billion for the third consecutive month. However, the rapid growth of semiconductor exports has raised concerns that if the AI investment boom cools, Korea’s economy may lack other industries to take over.

On September 1, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy released data showing that August exports grew 68.7% year‑on‑year to $98.25 billion, the third‑highest record ever, only behind June’s $102.0 billion and July’s $99.0 billion. Imports rose 22.5% to $63.51 billion, giving a trade surplus of $34.75 billion, the third month in a row exceeding $30 billion. After weekday adjustment, Korea’s average daily August exports were $4.47 billion, up 72.5% year‑on‑year, the fourth month in a row above $4 billion.

Semiconductors are undoubtedly the core of this export surge. August semiconductor exports reached $46.65 billion, a 209% jump from the same period last year, breaking the June record of $44.8 billion and marking the third consecutive month Korea’s semiconductor exports surpassed $40 billion. The Korean government cited the main driver as large cloud service providers expanding AI infrastructure capital spending, with Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) among the biggest cloud operators continuing to invest in AI data centers and computing infrastructure.

Korean semiconductor firms are also directly benefiting from AI server demand. SK hynix (SKHY‑US) listed its ADR on Nasdaq in July, trading under the code SKHY, becoming one of the most watched Korean companies amid the global AI memory demand boom. SK hynix holds a leading position in the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) market, and recent strong AI investment continues to push up memory prices and demand.

Beyond semiconductors, Korea’s export structure has also improved to some extent. August non‑semiconductor exports grew 20% year‑on‑year, with 14 of the top 20 items expanding. Computer exports surged 419.5% to $6.24 billion, a monthly record, largely driven by rising prices of enterprise‑grade SSD core components NAND. Wireless communication equipment exports grew 21.2% to $1.88 billion, buoyed by sales of the Galaxy S26, Z Fold 8 and Z Flip 8, and have grown for ten consecutive months.

The rise in memory prices has become an important factor in the rapid expansion of export values. Korean government data show that the fixed price of DDR5 16 Gb rose from $35 in April to $46.5 in August, while NAND 128 Gb rose from $24.2 in April to $30.5 in August. This means that even if shipment volumes do not increase at the same pace, price increases alone will lift export values.

Regionally, Korea’s August exports show a clear technology‑driven pattern. Exports to the United States grew 89.3% year‑on‑year, to China surged 119.3%, and to ASEAN rose 75.4%; but exports to the Middle East fell 15%, indicating that recovery speeds vary across industries and markets.

This is also why economists are beginning to warn of a “too‑good‑to‑be‑true” situation. Jeff Ng, Head of Asia Strategy at Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, estimated that nearly 80% of August export growth came from semiconductors, with overall growth driven mainly by chips, computers and rising oil product prices.

Moody’s Analytics economist Dave Chia believes that if the semiconductor boom merely slows gradually, Korea’s economy should still cope, but if exports suddenly stall, the situation would be very different. Korea’s economy currently operates at “two speeds”: semiconductor and tech industries expand rapidly, while other industries that need to carry the growth momentum are under pressure.

The automotive industry is one example. Korea’s August automotive exports fell 29.8% year‑on‑year to $3.85 billion, mainly due to the shift of the summer holiday period from the end of July last year to early August this year, and production disruptions from some strikes. Shipbuilding exports also fell 45.9% to $1.69 billion due to reduced delivery volumes.

However, the decline in automotive exports is not entirely structural. In addition to short‑term factors such as holiday timing and strikes, Moody’s Analytics also pointed out that U.S. tariff policy and the trend of automakers gradually shifting production to the United States could exert more lasting pressure on Korean automotive exports.

Other traditional Korean industries are also affected by global energy prices and supply conditions. August oil product exports grew 65.3% year‑on‑year to $6.84 billion, and petrochemical exports rose 12.2% to $3.86 billion, mainly because risks of passage through the Hormuz Strait pushed international oil prices higher, keeping export unit prices high. However, oil product export volumes actually fell 2.2%, and petrochemical export volumes dropped 7%, showing that much of the export value growth came from price factors.

On the other hand, Korea’s secondary battery exports reached $600 million in August, up 24% year‑on‑year, growing for the fourth consecutive month, mainly due to rising lithium and other mineral prices, new electric‑vehicle product orders, and a vibrant energy‑storage system (ESS) market. This indicates that, aside from semiconductors, some high‑tech export sectors are also improving.

The Bank of Korea’s monetary policy may also become an important variable for the next phase of economic performance. In August, the Bank raised its policy rate by 25 bps to 3%, its second consecutive rate hike, partly because core inflation remains relatively high. While Korea’s economy has been buoyed by strong exports, high rates may limit further domestic demand expansion.

Chia warns that if chip demand starts to cool while the Bank of Korea remains in a tightening stance, the “unexpected windfall” from exports may fade, and domestic demand may not fill the gap, putting greater pressure on economic growth.

However, the Bank of Korea also noted in its August monetary policy decision that consumer recovery is gradually accelerating, and that August non‑semiconductor exports still grew 20%, showing that Korea’s economy is not entirely dependent on chip exports. The Korean government also believes that a 20% growth in non‑semiconductor items indicates that the export growth base is expanding.

Lombard Odier senior strategist Homin Lee said that if semiconductor export momentum gradually weakens while other cyclical industries maintain good performance, Korea still has a chance to sustain about 2%–3% real annual growth.

The market currently does not expect Korean semiconductor exports to reverse immediately. SMBC’s Ng expects that Korea’s overall exports will remain positive for the next 12 months, but as the high base effect from last year fades and commodity prices gradually stabilize, the annual growth rate may slow from its current level.

Korean semiconductor and tech export growth is indeed unusually strong, but Lombard Odier’s Lee does not see this as a case of “over‑dependence.” He points out that Korea still has automotive, shipbuilding, chemical and other cyclical industries that usually benefit when the global economy expands. The real issue is not whether semiconductor exports will always grow at ultra‑high speed, but whether other industries can step in when the AI chip boom normalizes.

Recent data also show that Korea’s exports remain in a rare strong phase. August total exports have surpassed $90 billion for the third consecutive month, and semiconductor monthly exports set a new record; but as the share of semiconductors in exports approaches half, any shift in AI capital spending, memory prices or global tech sentiment could have a more direct transmission effect on Korea’s overall economy.

items.title: 美債拉警報！海外美資產避險比率創逾十年低　專家：貶值交易回溫 美元若崩將引發連續爆倉
items.title_en: US Bonds Raise Alarm! Overseas US Asset Hedging Ratio Hits Ten-Year Low; Experts Say Depreciation Trades Are Heating Up, and a Dollar Collapse Could Trigger Continuous Liquidations
paras: 外媒最新報導出，根據日本、加拿大、台灣、澳洲、丹麥及芬蘭等六地退休基金與保險公司申報文件，截至今年6月30日，海外投資人持有美股美債的外幣曝險避險比率僅約41%，創2015年來新低。
去年川普推出全球關稅、美元急貶時，上述避險比率曾短暫跳升，但這股熱潮隨著美元回穩、避險成本居高不下而迅速消退，投資人重回「波動時美元自動避險」的舊策略，也就是靠美元升值緩衝本幣計價的美國資產回撤，省下昂貴的衍生品費用。
但美元本季跌約2%、兌多數G10貨幣走弱，「貶值交易」(debasement trade)重新升溫，加上美日聯手干預日元、美國財政部擴大長債回購來壓抑殖利率，加上市場質疑聯準會(Fed)主席華許會否真升息抗通膨，均加劇「美國政策侵蝕美元」的敘事。
匯率避險是利用衍生性商品賣出美元、買進投資人本國貨幣，以防範匯率波動。由於美國資產在全球投資組合中佔有很大比重，增加避險其實意味著更多美元賣盤。
管理1.4兆美元的Nuveen宏觀信貸主管Laura Coope指出，海外持美資產規模龐大，避險比率只需小幅上調，就能撬動可觀外匯流量。根據測算，上述六地合計4.6兆美元外幣部位中，避險比率每上升5個百分點，等於約2300億美元交易量。
雖然上述估算未納入英國和歐元區等主要市場，但所涵蓋國家仍占美國資產海外持有量相當大的一部分。日本是全球最大的美國國債海外持有國，佔外國持有量約10%，加拿大和台灣也高居前十名。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that, based on filing documents from pension funds and insurance companies in Japan, Canada, Taiwan, Australia, Denmark and Finland, the foreign‑currency hedging ratio for overseas investors’ US equity and US Treasury holdings was only about 41% as of June 30 this year, a new low not seen since 2015.

Last year, when President Trump rolled out global tariffs and the dollar sharply depreciated, the hedging ratio briefly spiked, but the rally faded quickly as the dollar steadied and hedging costs remained high. Investors reverted to the old “automatic dollar hedge in volatile times” approach—relying on a stronger dollar to cushion the pull‑back of US‑denominated assets priced in local currencies and saving on expensive derivatives fees.

However, the dollar has fallen roughly 2% this quarter and weakened against most G10 currencies, reviving “debasement trades.” Combined with coordinated US‑Japan intervention in the yen, the US Treasury’s expanded long‑bond buybacks to suppress yields, and market doubts about whether Fed Chair Jerome Powell will truly raise rates to combat inflation, the narrative that “US policy is eroding the dollar” has intensified.

Currency hedging uses derivatives to sell dollars and buy the investor’s home currency to guard against exchange‑rate swings. Because US assets make up a large share of global portfolios, increasing hedges actually means more dollar selling pressure.

Laura Coope, head of macro credit at Nuveen, which manages $1.4 trillion, notes that overseas holdings of US assets are massive, and a modest uptick in the hedging ratio could mobilise a sizable FX flow. Her calculations show that among the six jurisdictions, the combined $4.6 trillion foreign‑currency exposure would generate about $230 billion of transaction volume for each 5‑percentage‑point rise in the hedging ratio.

Although the estimate excludes major markets such as the UK and the euro‑area, the covered countries still represent a substantial share of overseas US‑asset holdings. Japan is the world’s largest foreign holder of US Treasury bonds, accounting for roughly 10% of foreign holdings, with Canada and Taiwan also ranking among the top ten.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】日債收益率飆升，日圓大幅上揚
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Japanese Bond Yields Surge, Yen Rises Sharply
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國再對伊朗襲擊，伊朗則進行報復，持續推高油價及引發通貨膨脹擔憂，而且美國公債收益率上升及市場對美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)升息的預期升溫，增強美元作為避險貨幣的吸引力，週三推升美元兌日圓至160.39高點，但美國財政部長貝森特會晤日本央行(BOJ)總裁植田和男，呼籲BOJ採取果斷貨幣政策應對通貨膨脹和避免匯率過度波動，植田和男亦強調通貨膨脹風險，強化9月加息的預期，而且BOJ審議委員高田創敦促BOJ靈活實施加息，應對日益加劇的通貨膨脹壓力，導致日本十年期公債收益率1996年以來首度突破3%關卡，此門檻不僅對日本政府的融資成本意義重大，更將扭轉此前日本成為美國公債頭號持有者及全球最可靠主權債務買家的資金流向，儘管目前無跡象日本拋售其2.4兆美元海外債券持倉，但全球基金經理及日益增多數據顯示日本穩步減持此類資產，激勵日圓上揚。

隨後美國商務部公布7月耐久財訂單修正較前月持平於1.1%及工廠訂單較前月增加0.9%優於預期，但ADP全國就業報告顯示，8月美國民間就業崗位增加3.8萬個不及預估值，並據紐約聯邦儲備銀行總裁威廉姆斯稱，長期債劵收益率上升並非由通貨膨脹擔憂所致，而是反映經濟穩健發展，但路透調查，市場普遍認為FED最終升息幅度低於當前定價反映的水平，美元未來一年會走弱，而且市場懷疑美國或日本進行匯率詢價，重創美元兌日圓至158.29低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.70-90，支撐於157.50-70。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲統計局公布第二季實質國內生產總值(GDP)較前季增長0.4%高於預期，促使澳洲央行(RBA)本月升息的機率提高至57%及完全消化11月前加息的可能性，支撐澳幣持穩，並據紐西蘭央行(RBNZ) 上調官方隔夜拆款利率(OCR)25個基點至2.75%，但暗示未來可能漸進地進一步收緊貨幣政策，壓抑紐元走勢，拖累歐元兌美元跌至1.1565低點。

隨後數據顯示，法國8月預算赤字擴大至1,459.1億歐元，但義大利8月生產者物價指數(PPI)分別較前月與上年同期擴大漲幅至2.4%及7.8%，而且歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員馬赫盧夫表示，若通貨膨脹開始朝著錯誤方向發展，ECB絕不能迴避進一步加息，而且德國經濟研究所(DIW)稱，因德國出口表現強於預期及伊朗戰爭引發的能源價格衝擊相對溫和，大幅上調德國經濟2026年增長至1.2%，高出先前預測一倍以上，激勵歐元兌美元至1.1608高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1590-1.1610，支撐於1.1500-20。
◆GBP/USD
